semiconductor_relevance: High — TherMap Solutions provides advanced thermal characterization instrumentation critical for optimizing thermal management in semiconductor devices.
summary: TherMap Solutions designs and manufactures advanced laser-based thermal characterization tools that enable accurate measurement of thermal properties essential for high-power semiconductor devices. Their technology facilitates improved R&D feedback and quality control in the manufacturing process, particularly for complex multilayer structures.
capabilities: Thermal management solutions for high-power devices

regional_presence.United Kingdom: TherMap Solutions is a spin-out from the University of Bristol, indicating a strong presence in the UK.
